title: As Jacob With Travel Was Weary

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [Gm]At night [F]on a stone for a pillow [C]he lay;
[Am]He saw in a vision [C/G]a ladder [Bb]so high
[Am]That its [C]foot was on [Am]earth and [Gm]its top [F]in the sky.

sections.name: Refrain
lines: [Gm]And has [F]raised up a ladder of mercy [C]for me,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [C]Come [F]let us ascend! All may [Gm]climb it who will;
[Gm]For the [F]angels of Jacob are guarding [C]it still:
[Am]And remember each [C]step that by [Bb]faith we passo'er,

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [C]And [F]when we arrive at the [Gm]haven of rest
[Gm]We shall [F]hear the glad words, "Come up hither, [C]ye blest,
[Am]Here are regions of [C]light, here are [Bb]mansions of bliss."
